translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: MAK
book.title: MAK Mak ere bas rasem tuma yenbo.

content: Jisas ere let gwori tame erne let segilin eyarem.
Jisas ere God eteri akek sene wurin lam, let gwori tame ere etek temenem.

Temenem, kau tame eme Jisas erne tuma namdete keluke sopem. Etepkap eme erne lek ten etep abobetem. Gwopte ege si yabel. Ere kap let gwori tame erne let sene segilin eyarte o? Ere etep tete, nema erne kuyese tuma namdete.
Eme etepke abom, Jisas ere let gwori tame erne etep wom. Ne gwok yan etemri borke yan tetete.

Etep wom, ere tatame emne etep wometem. Wule ere mapeke wobe? Ege si yabel nema beke nente? Ege si yabel nema wule yenbo nente, o nema wule yaper nente? Ege si yabel tame sate nenbetete, nema erne kobo lan eyarte, o nema erne pik pen sate? Ere emne etep wometem, eme awosein beke wo.

Awosein beke wo, ere emne lan sewuren pap wayem. Eme eteke lan eme elpenalpem, eke Jisas ere emne kobo late abom. Kobo late abom, ere let gwori tame erne etep wom. Ne let tai. Let tayemke, eri let yenbo tem.
Yenbo tem, Farisi tame eme God eteri ake mesginin yin Herot eri anepoi tame etemken namdem. Eme etep wom. Nema Jisas erne pen sate. Etep wom.
Tatame nogwape eme peik kupa barke wurisubuk sim.
Jisas ere eteri anepoi tameken eme kena yite abom, eme Galili peik kupak yin temenem. Yin temenem, Galili distrikri tatame nogwape eme erne semowum.

Juda yekwori tatame, Jerusalem komri tatame, Idumea yekwori tatame, Jordan peik yekwok temenem tatame, Tairken Saidonken kom sag pes mekinke temenem tatame eme akei yam. Jisas ere nenbetem wos eme metem, eme erne late yam.
Erne late yam, ere anepoi tame emne etep wom. Kem ane pere wuri sen yan mekinke gaite. Tatame eme ane mane yan mekin mekin tetkwunte. Etep wom.
Kiyi ere tatame nogwape emne eyarbetem, eme eterne kerelate awoawo ginbetem. Eme etepke abom. Nema erne kerelate, nema sene eyar tete.
Etepke abom, gabo gulelemenem tatame eme erne lamke, eme gulwarke pan erne muresen etep wom. Ne God Eteri Yen.
Ere emne noubke etep wom. An God Eteri Yen, kem tatame emne etep mane wusoute. Etep wom.
Jisas ere ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo pes kei tame (12-pela) emne yaku newom.
Sene Jisas ere kowke yawen kau tame emne won yam.
Yam, ere ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes kei (12-pela) tame emne etep wom. Kem arenken tete. An kemne Aposel yaku newon, kem kom komke yin ari tuma wusoute.
An kemne mure newote, kem gabo emne ari murek kuyese pekeroukte.
Etek wom tame ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tewo bor pes kei (12-pela) tame emri sig gwo. Wuri ere Saimon. Jisas ere erne akeite sig Pita wom.
Pes epe Jemsken eri mase Jonken. Epe Sebedi eteri yen. Jisas ere akeite sig epne tem. Sig et Boanerges. Sig somo gwo. Waketekap pebe tame.
Akeite emri sig gwo. Andru, Filip, Bartolomyu, Matyu, Tomas, Jems. Jems ere Alfius eteri yen. Pes epe Tadiusken Saimon Selotken.
Wuri ere Judas Iskariot. Yuri ere Jisas erne yena tem.
Eme etep wom. Jisas ere Belsebul eterken yaku kerebe.
Sene Jisas ere maime komke sene yim. Sene yim, tatame nogwape eme wurisubuk sin ere emne tuma wusowum. Wusowum, Jisas eter, eri anepoi tameken eme yaku eisau kerem, eme a beke a.
A beke a, Jisas eri nawoken eri maseken eme etep metem, eme etep wom. Jisas ere me belebe. Etep wom, eme yan, eme erne panen yite yam.

Moses eri wule wusoubetem tame eme Jerusalem komke mesginin yeirin, eme etep wom. Satan ere gabo etemri apeilake. Eri sig wuri e Belsebul. Eter ere Jisas erne gulelemenem. Ere Jisas erne mure newom, eke ere gabo emne pekeroukbe.
Etep wom, Jisas ere tatame emne won yam, ere sekur sakur tuma emne etep wom. Ere emne wometem. Satan ere mapeke eter maime lelete?
Keryen wuri eri wakse eme pekan etemwou etemwou naite, eme som beke kip te, eme yikwute yakwutete nenbe.
Ane wuri eri yen eme etemwou etemwou naite, eme som beke kip te. Eme yikwute yakwutete nenbe.
Satanken omogaboken eme etepkapke tete. Satan ere eteri wakseken naitek, eme beke kip te. Eme yikwute yakwutete, eme noub beke te.

Jisas ere sekur sakur tuma sene etep wom. Tame ere mureken tame eteri akek wurte wote, ere eteri wos pette wote, kiyi ere yin ete murken tame erne kepke peten bogun raste. Bogun raste, ere kuyese wurin wos ek pette. Etepkap, an Satan erne kepke peiken rasbe. Rasbe, Satan ere kiyi petem tatame an emne sene petbe.

An kemne sekenke wobe. Tatame eme wule yaper nente, God ere emri nenbe wule yaper peten sepitite, ere tuma beke kip wo. O eme God erne tuma yaper wotek, God ere ete wule yaper peten sepitite, ere tuma beke kip wo.
Tatame eme God Eteri Wou eterne tuma yaper wote, God ere emri nenbe wule yaper beke kip peten sepit, ere emne tuma namdete. Gwopte, yuri etepwou ere beke kip peten sepit. Etep wom.
Kiyi eme etep wom. Gabo ere Jisas erne guleleten, ere gabo emne pekeroukbe. Etep womke, Jisas ere emne ete tuma wom.
Eike eme Jisas eteri nawoken eri maseken?
Jisas eri nawoken maseken eme yan kom genik tetpete wurmenem. Wurmenem, eme erne tuma wopete wurin etep wom. Nema nerenken tuma namdete.
Etep womke, tatame nogwape eme eterken mekinke simenem, eme erne etep wom. Metye. Neri nawoken maseken eme yawo, kom genik kouten.
Ere awosein etep wom. An kemne peterate, eike ari nawo, eike ari mase.
Eterken mekinke simenem tatame ere emne lan etep wom. Ek la. Gwo tatame eme ari nawokap, ari masekap.
Tatame eme God eri tuma meten tobote, ete tatame etem eme ari nawokap geisimasekap. Ere etep wom.
